author: Justice Kennedy
holding: Created the 'new context' plus 'special factors' framework for evaluating Bivens claims. Virtually any factual variation from the three recognized contexts counts as a 'new context,' and the presence of any special factor — national security, congressional activity, alternative remedial processes — blocks extension.
effect_on_bivens: Formalized the refusal to extend Bivens and created a framework that makes future extension nearly impossible.
